==Notes==
This template is one in a series of modular source templates meant to be used to generate navigation templates.

==Usage instructions==
<pre><nowiki>{{Nav_end}}</nowiki></pre>

'''NOTE:''' An optional '''edit''' variable can be used to add an edit link.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Nav_end|edit=''TEMPLATE NAME''}}

==Navigation source templates==
*{{Tl|Nav_start}}
*{{Tl|Nav_heading}}
*{{Tl|Nav_text}}
*{{Tl|Nav_end}}

==Example==
===Code===
<pre><nowiki>
{{Nav_start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav_heading|Heading 1}}
{{Nav_text|blah blah blah blah blah}}
{{Nav_heading|Heading 2}}
{{Nav_text|blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah}}
{{Nav_end}}
</nowiki></pre>

===Result===
{{Nav_start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav_heading|Heading 1}}
{{Nav_text|blah blah blah blah blah}}
{{Nav_heading|Heading 2}}
{{Nav_text|blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah}}
{{Nav_end}}
